verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building your own agents. A framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship a built-in assistant (for example, a copilot in its tooling), so the axis applies. The evidence only covers primitives for constructing agents (graphs, persistence, interrupts, streaming). The 'assistants' endpoints on the Agent Server expose user-built graphs, not a first-party AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to inside the product.
